hello.text: Hm? Oh, hello. Sorry, I was miles away.

busy.text: Every day's busy in {npc.place}. There's water to fetch, roofs to patch and a hundred other things.

road.text: Follow it far enough and you'll reach {npc.town}. Keep away from the {npc.campDir}, though. {npc.camp} is no place for travellers.
